Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Switched from Default to Advanced mode and built a multi-query alert rule
- Used Reduce and Math expressions to transform and compare query results
- Configured a recovery threshold to prevent alert flapping
- Set the alert condition on a specific expression in the pipeline
- Saved the rule and verified it evaluates correctly

---
